text:
evalbot: nightly-eval ALERT 03:12 UTC — 3 suites failed: short-seq-cohort, safety-lite, instr-fewshot-generalization. severity=P2. samples attached below.

maria: seeing lots of truncated / blank outputs for short prompts, and a few hallucinations mixed in. picking a few samples now.

jin: can you paste the failing prompt ids and one raw example each?

evalbot: failed_ids: [sco-421, sco-422, sl-10, ifg-77]

Here are two raw failing outputs (from nightly run):
```
PROMPT: "Translate: hi"
MODEL: model-x-int4
OUTPUT: ""
```
```
PROMPT: "Summarize: \"Q: price?\""
MODEL: model-x-int4
OUTPUT: "The product costs" <-- cut off, no number, weird stop token.
```

sam: hmm looks like an early-stop / tokenization boundary issue. this was introduced after the int4 bringup yesterday?

maria: int4 quant merge landed 2026-03-19 22:30 UTC to staging, then promoted to nightly-run pool.

leah: I'll check runtime logs for decode errors / invalid token IDs. can someone grep for kv-cache mismatch too?

jin: grabbing model artifacts and will run local reproducer w/ the same eval harness. command i use: `tools/eval_run --model model-x --quant=int4 --suite short-seq-cohort --samples 50`

oncall-bot: incident created #4567 (nightly-eval-shortseq) — owner: @jin, notify: eng-ml, eng-runtime

maria: proposed immediate steps: 1) reproduce locally on a dev GPU (jin) 2) run same eval on float32/float16 model variant to check if regression is quant-only (sam) 3) check recent kernel/runtime change that toggled batch defaults (leah) 4) collect 10 golden prompts that used to pass for quick diff (maria)

sam: i'll run float16 baseline now and post metrics. if float baseline passes -> rollback route: pin route to model-x-fp16 for hosted nightly and pause int4 runs.

leah: FYI I noticed batch_size default was bumped from 1 -> 8 in the harness config on 2026-03-19. small sequences + larger batch may interact badly with kv cache in the int4 path. rolling batch_size back for a quick smoke.

jin: reproduced one blank output locally with int4 + batch 8. switching to batch 1 gives normal output. reproducer logs: `decode: err=0, stop_token_seen=false, emitted_len=0` — suggests early cut. pushing debug build with extra token debug.

maria: good find. severity -> P2 still but now we have an actionable hypothesis (batch interaction). assigning owners: @jin (repro + debug), @leah (runtime/batching), @sam (baseline + rollback plan).

sam: ETA: float16 run in ~25m, will open rollback PR if passes.

jin: will run extended reproducer and attach filtered failing prompts within 90m.

maria: thanks team. tag me when you have a failing sample list and the PR for rollback. i'll summarize for support and customer ops. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: reminder: if we escalate to P1, ping oncall. for now monitoring and owners assigned.

leah: quick note — if batch default change fixed the issue in local smoke, consider hotfix to runtime to defer batching on short sequences while we audit quant decode path.

sam: acknowledged. posting interim update in 30m.

[thread closed for now — followups in incident #4567]
